technical.summary: WEC shows extreme oversold conditions with long-term bullish structure (EMA/SMA 50/200), but price is below all intermediate moving averages, MACD is bearish, and recent downside breakouts signal continued weakness—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: WEC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 33 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is absent and stale (127+ days old), offering no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (329.92) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures utilities with any international exposure, and earnings in 33 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI across all periods combined with long-term EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish structure and price near support (83.56) creates contrarian mean-reversion setup in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price is below all intermediate moving averages, MACD is bearish with negative histogram, recent downside breakouts of Donchian channels signal continued weakness, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, earnings risk in 33 days) make this a trap for oversold bounces rather than a sustainable entry.
